svg.title: Design sheet · Hero mask and crown
svg.text: Design sheet · Hero mask and crown
Eyes open. The mask leaves a gap around each eye; the crown sits on the forehead. Lesson 04.6, project 5.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
On a real face: eye-safe paint for the mask, no glitter or gems near the lashes.
